extracted.name: Blackberry Syrup
extracted.description: Blackberry syrup is super easy to make in minutes with blackberry juice and sugar for a fruity and delicious topping on pancakes or desserts.
instruction_lines: Mix blackberry juice and sugar together in a large saucepan; bring to a boil. Boil rapidly for 2 minutes.
Skim off any foam from top of the mixture.
Carefully ladle or pour into sterile jars or bottles. Store syrup in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.
